title: Tensorisation of the two-function hypercontractive inequality
statement:
Fix exponents $p, q \ge 1$ and a noise parameter $\rho$ with $0 \le \rho \le 1$, and write $T_\rho$ for the associated noise operator. Suppose the two-function bound
\[
  \langle f, T_\rho g\rangle \;\le\; \bigl(\E[\abs{f}^p]\bigr)^{1/p}\,\bigl(\E[\abs{g}^q]\bigr)^{1/q}
\]
holds for every pair of Boolean functions $f, g \colon \{0,1\}^1 \to \bbr$ on the one-dimensional cube. Then, for every $n$, the same inequality holds for every pair of Boolean functions $f, g \colon \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$.
hypotheses_covered: base case: the two-function bound holds for all f, g on the 1-dimensional cube
replaced:
Let $p, q \ge 1$ and $0 \le \rho \le 1$. If
$\inn{f, T_\rho g} \le (\E[\abs{f}^p])^{1/p}(\E[\abs{g}^q])^{1/q}$ holds for all
$f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,1 \to \bbr$, then the same bound holds for all $n$ and all
$f, g : \mathrm{BoolCube}\,n \to \bbr$.
